title: Keep a normalised list
summary: A list with ids can be stored as an id array plus a lookup object.
introduction: A list with ids can be stored as an id array plus a lookup object. Your task: Look up the first book by its id.
learningObjectives: Look up the first book by its id.
Explain the example for keep a normalised list

blocks.text: A list with ids can be stored as an id array plus a lookup object. This makes finding one record direct and avoids duplicate copies.

Use an Angular project with the matching major version of @ngrx/store. Effects and SignalStore examples also need @ngrx/effects or @ngrx/signals. Save linked snippets in the files named by their imports.
Read the code step by step

items: The ids array records the chosen item ordering.
The entities object provides direct lookup from an id to the record holding that book's facts.

blocks.text: The lookup returns Garden Days for b2. NgRx Entity can manage this common shape in larger features.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Keep the ids and entity records in step. A missing lookup needs a handled fallback.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Look up the first book by its id.
